title: Neon Turtle Sloth Bubble
description: A glowing sea turtle with a vibrant pink and cyan shell patterned with coral floats inside a large transparent bubble against a black background. A sloth's head and arms emerge from the turtle's shell, smiling, while neon blue and purple energy lines, small fish, and coral fragments swirl within the bubble.
prompt: A surreal glowing sea turtle with intricate neon pink and cyan coral patterns on its shell, swimming inside a large transparent bubble. A happy sloth is emerging from within the turtle's shell, smiling at the viewer. Bright blue and purple energy tendrils, tiny glowing fish and coral float around them. Black background with floating neon particles, vibrant bioluminescent aesthetic, highly detailed digital artwork.
